rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2AA label and gives a plausible blastocyst description, but it overstates image-specific certainty and includes features not reliably assessable from a single image (e.g., no collapse artifact, distinct cell borders, perivitelline debris significance, no multinucleation).
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, response to stimulation, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include some speculative quantitative adjustments and slight inconsistency around euploidy estimates.

Mostly evidence-based and appropriate on SET, luteal support, and counseling, but some recommendations are less guideline-grounded or overstated (assisted hatching as reasonable, routine continuation of progesterone to 10–12 weeks, CoQ10/DHEA suggestions).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, monitoring, cryopreservation, and contingency planning for future cycles, with useful case-specific nuance.
